ml_kem_768.key_hardening: Generate via provider; export FIPS-203 expanded dk; re-import explicit dk; scrub application-owned dk copy immediately; destroy original generated handle.
ml_kem_768.ntt_boundary: Provider-owned. OpenSSL upstream documents constant-time ML-KEM implementation methods; W-3 does not claim an independent audit of internal NTT butterfly assembly/C.
ml_kem_768.decapsulation_note: Successful KEM decapsulation is not peer authentication; subsequent traffic must authenticate using a key derived from the shared secret.

hdc_phasor.simd: AVX2 four-complex-lane multiply when available; scalar fallback otherwise
hdc_phasor.fst_binding: raw IEEE-754 lane bits XOR per-lane FST mask
hdc_phasor.unbinding: FST XOR reversal followed by multiplication by complex conjugate; conjugate sign flip uses one SIMD XOR per four complex lanes
hdc_phasor.security_ceiling: Reversible HDC binding transform only; not AEAD and not a substitute for a standard symmetric cipher.

stage8_zeroization.application_memory: explicit_bzero on supported libc platforms, volatile byte scrub fallback, followed by volatile zero verification

handoff.directive: Benchmark the committed crypto_core.c/.h with -lcrypto. BM-02 may measure HDC bind/unbind throughput. BM-06 may verify Aura-owned buffers after aura_stage8_zeroize, but must not claim zero residual bytes inside opaque OpenSSL provider memory without provider-level instrumentation or source-grounded proof.

nonclaims: No FIPS/CMVP module validation is claimed for the local default OpenSSL provider.
No independent verification of OpenSSL internal NTT constant-time behavior is claimed.
No claim that the HDC phasor transform provides authenticated encryption is made.
